The Ogun State Police Command said it has arrested two suspects in two separate operations by its Special Weapons and Tactics Unit. The state Police Public Relations Officer, Oluseyi Babaseyi, said in a statement on Friday that the operations led to the arrest of Mutiu Isa and Adeyemi Adebola. According to the police, a locally made cut-to-size shotgun, a live cartridge, an axe, a toy pistol, charms and hand gloves were recovered from the suspects. The statement said, “In the first operation, at about 1:45 a.m. on 25 November 2026, SWAT personnel, acting on credible intelligence, arrested Mutiu Isa of Ajilete, Ogun State. “A subsequent search of his residence led to the recovery of an axe, a toy pistol, charms and hand gloves. The suspect remains in police custody as investigations continue.
